input.quote: 10. NONASSIGNABILITY. Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: The only assignment provision (§ 10) requires mutual prior written consent, not unreasonably withheld, but contains no carve-out permitting Company to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets. The fallback position requires at least a right to assign to successors (with notice), so the clause fails the fallback on a material term. Direction is symmetric, so the restriction does bind us. Mitigating: the consent standard is reasonableness-qualified and there is no change-of-control trigger anywhere — § 6 termination rights are limited to convenience (no outstanding SOW) and uncured material breach, so no Vendor exit or re-pricing on our change of control. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for Company and the no-competitor limit on Contractor assignment, reaching the preferred position with a minimal edit.

proposal.summary: Add Company affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and bar assignment to a Company competitor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out letting us assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, since internal reorganisations and corporate transactions should not require Contractor's consent. We also confirmed Contractor cannot assign to one of our competitors; the mutual "not unreasonably withheld" consent standard is otherwise unchanged.

ops.oldText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided, however, that Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and Contractor shall not in any event assign or transfer this Agreement to a competitor of Company.
